title: Using Existing CLO Blazer Patterns as a Starting Point in 2D Pattern Draft
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202607/615a2417ad934a19b017af4986619f8b/images/10dc893f9fa0438b8ffdf3d90e5a2619Screenshot%202026-07-15%20105218.png)Hello CLO Team,

I am planning to draft a bespoke blazer jacket for myself and would like to use the **2D Pattern Draft** tool to modify an existing CLO pattern.

I have downloaded the KOFOTI Female Blazer Pattern from CONNECT Official as well as the CLO Women Blazer Pattern from the Modular Library. However, when I go to **2D Pattern Draft > Pattern Type > Select**, the only available option seems to be the basic T-shirt.

Could you please advise whether it is possible to upload or import an existing CLO blazer pattern into the **2D Pattern Draft** tool and use it as the starting point for drafting and customizing a bespoke tailored jacket? If so, could you briefly explain the workflow?

Many thanks

Lucy Zhang from Winchester School of Art

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Yes, it is same as I used during our workshop.🙂
Reply 1: Hi, my colleague edited your account's permissions. Can you try again?

Comment 2: Thanks for your help❤️ I'm trying to book the Men's Denim Jeans and Men's Sportscoat online focus courses, but the system says I need to complete Introduction to CLO first.I've already attended the Intro to CLO Public Workshop (06/2026) with Melody Tennessee. Is there a way to have this recognized so I can book these courses directly?Thanks so much for any advice! 😊
Reply 1: Hi there, I have asked a colleague who monitors the CLO Academy and will get back to you asap with an answer!
Reply 2: Are you already registered as a learner? If not, please do so. My colleague can then find your account and remove the restriction. We only need confirmation which name you are using so he can find it. (It suffices to let me know if it was the same you used during our workshop 🙂)
content_description: This web page aims to provide guidance on importing and customizing existing CLO blazer patterns within the 2D Pattern Draft tool for bespoke jacket design.
